purpose.domain_detail: BBS (Bulletin Board System) administration panel — 'MAKERS BBS' — handling payment processing and user management
purpose.summary: This program implements an interactive terminal-based admin server for a BBS system called 'MAKERS BBS'. It presents menu-driven screens for an administrator to process payments (single entry or batch bank statement), manage users, and navigate the admin interface. It calls subprograms 'process-single-payment' and 'process-bank-statement' and uses a user-defined function to convert monetary amounts to credits.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with full-screen TUI (BLANK SCREEN, REVERSE-VIDEO, HIGHLIGHT, BLINK, UNDERLINE, FOREGROUND-COLOR)
REPOSITORY clause declaring user-defined function CONV-MON-TO-CRED
LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING (called as subprogram)
Recursive PERFORM pattern for menu loops (no GOTO)
verdict.notes: Program type is ambiguous — it uses LINKAGE SECTION and PROCEDURE DIVISION USING suggesting it is a subprogram called from a main server, yet it also calls STOP RUN directly. The SCREEN SECTION and interactive ACCEPT/DISPLAY suggest a terminal-based online program rather than batch. Dialect is likely GnuCOBOL based on *> comments and SCREEN SECTION features, but no compiler directives confirm this. One line slightly exceeds 72 chars (col 73).
